local data={
	-----Consumables Healing Items-----
	["Buckflower Powder"]={name="Buckflower Powder", tier=2, use="Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.", desc="Shredding would greatly improve the pharmaceutical effectiveness of Buckflower.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Citrome Powder"]={name="Citrome Powder", tier=2, use="Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.", desc="Shredding would greatly improve the flavors of Citrome.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Firebuckle Powder"]={name="Firebuckle Powder", tier=3, use="Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.", desc="A simple powdered preparation of Firebuckle. You can use it to treat wounds, but its pharmaceutical potential goes way beyond that.", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Citromix"]={name="Citromix", tier=3, use="Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.", desc="A simple blended preparation that can be consumed by mixing with some water. If you're unlucky, you might get some bitter bits of rind in your pack.", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Jincao Powder"]={name="Jincao Powder", tier=2, use="Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.", desc="Jincao plant can be shredded to a powder form. This must then be dissolved and packaged in a container for easier use.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Yazhen Powder"]={name="Yazhen Powder", tier=2, use="Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.", desc="Yazhen plant can be shredded to a powder form. This must then be dissolved and packaged in a container for easier use.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Fluffed Jincao Powder"]={name="Fluffed Jincao Powder", tier=3, use="Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.", desc="Jincao plant can be shredded to a powder form. This must then be dissolved and packaged in a container for easier use.", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Thorny Yazhen Powder"]={name="Thorny Yazhen Powder", tier=3, use="Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.", desc="Yazhen plant can be shredded to a powder form. This must then be dissolved and packaged in a container for easier use.", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Canned Citrome (C)"]={name="Canned Citrome (C)", tier=3, use="Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.", desc="A cheap can of citromes. This serves as an accessible source of vitamins for settlers in the wildlands.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Canned Citrome (B)"]={name="Canned Citrome (B)", tier=3, use="Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.", desc="Citrome now comes with revolutionary packaging. However, this was poorly received in the Civilization Band due to its excessive sugar content.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Canned Citrome (A)"]={name="Canned Citrome (A)", tier=4, use="Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.", desc="A can of citromes made with fruits grown in natural and wholesome orchards. Fortified with small amounts of the essential vitamin suite. However, suggested retail price seems to be higher than its worth.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Jincao Drink"]={name="Jincao Drink", tier=3, use="Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.", desc="A carbonated beverage with a dash of jincao herbal extract. The refreshing aroma made this a popular drink.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Jincao Tea"]={name="Jincao Tea", tier=4, use="Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.", desc="A carbonated beverage made with jincao herbs. The process of preparation is based on time-tested herbal therapeutic traditions.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Buck Capsule (C)"]={name="Buck Capsule (C)", tier=3, use="Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.", desc="A simple capsule made with crafting. It is quite leaky, and shaking it around might reduce its potency.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Buck Capsule (B)"]={name="Buck Capsule (B)", tier=3, use="Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.", desc="A capsule prepared using the processes of standard pharmaceutical packaging. Endfield Industries once tried to market this but the amount sold barely came to a fraction of the competing Rhodes Island product.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Buck Capsule (A)"]={name="Buck Capsule (A)", tier=4, use="Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.", desc="A capsule prepared using optimized packaging techniques. This Endfield product was designed for ease-of-use in combat scenarios.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Yazhen Syringe (C)"]={name="Yazhen Syringe (C)", tier=3, use="Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.", desc="Can only be administered via subcutaneous injection.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Yazhen Syringe (A)"]={name="Yazhen Syringe (A)", tier=4, use="Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.", desc="Endfield Industries once attempted to develop a Protocol-Injection technology but the project was eventually canned. They ultimately lacked the courage to unleash something that would revolutionize the entire industry.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Buckpill (S)"]={name="Buckpill (S)", tier=4, use="Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.", desc="A bottle of ingestible medicinal pills made with crafting.", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Buckpill (L)"]={name="Buckpill (L)", tier=4, use="Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.", desc="A bottle of medicinal pills made with crafting. This one offers a larger dosage compared to its basic counterpart.", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Buckpill (Rf.)"]={name="Buckpill (Rf.)", tier=5, use="Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.", desc="A pharmaceutical preparation made with simple processing. This one offers a larger dosage and better ingredients compared to its basic counterpart.", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Citromix (S)"]={name="Citromix (S)", tier=4, use="Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.", desc="A blended mix made with simple filling. It has a very invigorating aroma of citromes.", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Citromix (L)"]={name="Citromix (L)", tier=4, use="Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.", desc="A blended mix made with simple filling. This one offers a larger dosage compared to its basic counterpart.", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Citromix (Rf.)"]={name="Citromix (Rf.)", tier=5, use="Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.", desc="A blended mix made with simple filling. This one offers larger dosage and better ingredients compared to its basic counterpart.", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Jincao Tisane"]={name="Jincao Tisane", tier=4, use="Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.", desc="A traditional tisane made by brewing a special blend of secret Wuling herbs. The bitter taste will help you recall the saddest and most desperate times of your life.", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Jincao Infusion"]={name="Jincao Infusion", tier=5, use="Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.", desc="An herbal infusion made with simple brewing. Anyone who could chug down a bottle in one go can be regarded as a true \"hero\".", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Yazhen Spray (S)"]={name="Yazhen Spray (S)", tier=4, use="Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.", desc="A spray that can be made with crafting. Yazhen extracts make excellent insect repellents.", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Yazhen Spray (L)"]={name="Yazhen Spray (L)", tier=5, use="Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.", desc="A simple spray made with a filling unit. Administer orally if necessary.", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Arts Vial"]={name="Arts Vial", tier=3, use="Use this consumable to resuscitate an unconscious operator.", desc="A booster packaged in a vial imbued with Originium Arts. The contents activate the user's vitals, heighten the nervous system, and give an adrenaline boost.", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Bizarro Chili"]={name="Bizarro Chili", tier=4, use="Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.", desc="A uniquely flavored meat stew made using Anthony's family recipe. A wildland wanderer like Anthony often carried this chili along with him. It reminds him of home and gives him the calories he needs.", obtain="Mission rewards"},
	["Arts Tube"]={name="Arts Tube", tier=4, use="Use this consumable to resuscitate an unconscious operator.", desc="A booster packaged in a metallic tube imbued with Originium Arts. The contents activate the user's vitals, heighten the nervous system, and give a huge adrenaline boost.", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Garden Fried Rice"]={name="Garden Fried Rice", tier=4, use="Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.", desc="Fried rice made with less oil and salt to bring out the wholesome flavors of garden greens and vegetables.", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Master Pan's Egg Pudding"]={name="Master Pan's Egg Pudding", tier=4, use="Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.", desc="A vegetable egg pudding popular in a hot pot joint owned by an Ursus chef. It is an extremely delicious and beautiful looking dish... But the ingredients said nothing about eggs. How does anyone make this?", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Valley Pie"]={name="Valley Pie", tier=5, use="Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.", desc="A meat pie. Everyone in Valley IV grew up eating the famous Valley pie. Steaming pies, the stove, and a loving family always bring people hope.", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Meat Stir-Fry"]={name="Meat Stir-Fry", tier=5, use="Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.", desc="Cubes of meat stir-fried over hot fire. A hungry diner can easily go through three bowls of rice with a serving of meat stir-fry. There's a good reason why this is the *most* popular dish in the frontier.", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	-----Meals and Explosives-----
	["Meaty Buckflower Stew"]={name="Meaty Buckflower Stew", tier=2, use="Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.", desc="Despite the absolute lack of meat, this dish has a rich, hearty taste. Aggagrit seasoning may indeed revolutionize certain approaches to the culinary arts.", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Handmade Weirdrop"]={name="Handmade Weirdrop", tier=2, use="Use this consumable to improve the operator's combat performance.", desc="A candy with a sad, greenish color. Its preparation might be based on Landbreaker recipes. It tastes like licorice, but with an added dash of tartness.", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Seš'qa Style Fillet"]={name="Seš'qa Style Fillet", tier=2, use="Use this consumable to improve the operator's combat performance.", desc="A wholly black fillet with bits of bone inside it. Seš'qamam cuisine? Probably not. This feels more like a Landbreakers' fantasy about Seš'qamam food.", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Instant Bone Soup"]={name="Instant Bone Soup", tier=2, use="Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.", desc="A soup mix of aggagrit seasoning and special bone meal. Just add hot water. Despite its savory and wholesome flavors, tasters can't help but weirdly fantasize if the soup mix is just as good \"without the bone meal\".", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Stew Meeting"]={name="Stew Meeting", tier=2, use="Use this tactical to restore the operator's Ultimate Energy.", desc="A basin full of \"criminally generous riches\". It is obvious that this is prepared with more than one type of meat. Help yourself to a bowl or two. Such normal-looking food is a rarity, considering it was made in a hostile environment.", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Mini Honey Slugpudding"]={name="Mini Honey Slugpudding", tier=2, use="Use this tactical to restore the operator's Ultimate Energy.", desc="Citrome-flavored pudding with balanced sour and sweet flavors. Bits of aggagrit were added during boiling. Originium Slug extracts were then used to solidify the entire thing. This cloyingly sweet aroma is simply ... magnificent.", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Kunst Vial"]={name="Kunst Vial", tier=3, use="Use this consumable to improve the operator's combat performance.", desc="A booster packaged in a vial imbued with special Originium Arts. It contains sharp micro-clusters that can activate the user's vitals, excite the nervous system, and accelerate adrenaline secretion.", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Sod-Turning Meat Soup"]={name="Sod-Turning Meat Soup", tier=3, use="Use this consumable to improve the operator's combat performance.", desc="A meat soup with a fruity flavor. What did people eat on the first day of constructing the Hub Base? There are plenty of stories around, but many veterans claimed they had a fruity meat stew when they turned the sod.", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Cartilage Tack"]={name="Cartilage Tack", tier=3, use="Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.", desc="Savory cookies with bits of cartilaginous material inside it. Look cute but have an extremely dry and gagging taste. This recipe was rumored to be a Landbreaker creation. It would seem that these raiders are actually capable of focusing on the details. A rare occasion indeed.", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Edible Denstack"]={name="Edible Denstack", tier=3, use="Use this consumable to improve the operator's combat performance.", desc="A saucy condiment with plenty of aggagrit powder in it. Another ingredient in its preparation would be the chromatic lipids used by Bonekrusher Arsonists as fuel for their flamethrowers.", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Hazefyre Blossom"]={name="Hazefyre Blossom", tier=3, use="Use this consumable to improve the operator's combat performance.", desc="Despite looking edible, we do not recommend eating this. This is a smoked \"plant\" prepared by using hazefyre-tainted jerky in place of sawdust and special aggagrit to replace sugar. Only the \"bravest of the brave\" would dare try it.", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Old Man John's Burger"]={name="Old Man John's Burger", tier=3, use="Use this consumable to improve the operator's combat performance.", desc="Getting an authentic Mama John's burger is not easy for explorations operating in the field. But if you try hard enough, you can make something that is at least eighty-percent similar to the Mama's famous sandwiches.", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Cosmo-Melto Jelly"]={name="Cosmo-Melto Jelly", tier=3, use="Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.", desc="A jelly that people can easily prepare, even in the wildlands. Citromes can be dissolved in a mixture of two different types of aggagrits to create a strange jelly-like material.", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Superhot Slug Gratin"]={name="Superhot Slug Gratin", tier=3, use="Use this consumable to restore the operator's HP.", desc="A comfort food with comforting heat. It is an ancient legacy passed from one planet to another. It tastes of home.", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Secret Stimulating Tisane"]={name="Secret Stimulating Tisane", tier=3, use="Use this consumable to restore the operator's HP.", desc="A stimulating tisane prepared using Karja's secret formula. Don't drink it in daytime, though.", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Simple Pain Relief Salve"]={name="Simple Pain Relief Salve", tier=3, use="Use this consumable to restore the operator's HP.", desc="A pain relief salve prepared using Karja's secret formula. The salve is very popular amongst those engaged with heavy manual labor.", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Mystery Soda"]={name="Mystery Soda", tier=3, use="Use this consumable to improve the operator's combat performance.", desc="Pop it open and start chugging. Feel the fizz dance on your tongue, then give a satisfied burp. It's that simple.", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Mini Sugar Painting"]={name="Mini Sugar Painting", tier=3, use="Use this consumable to improve the operator's combat performance.", desc="An extremely simple snack. For expatriates who cannot return home ... a quick fix of nostalgia can be acquired in the most simple of sweets.", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Bamboo Sprouts and Meat"]={name="Bamboo Sprouts and Meat", tier=3, use="Use this consumable to improve the operator's combat performance.", desc="An everyday family dish prepared by stir-frying bamboo sprouts with meat strips. This is also the first dish that the children of Qingbo Stockade learn about ... or so they say.", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Perplexing Medication"]={name="Perplexing Medication", tier=4, use="Use this consumable to improve the operator's combat performance.", desc="A medicine prepared by Linnaeus. It is infused with his personal emotions and has a perplexing yet rich blend of flavors.", obtain="Mission rewards"},
	["Kunst Tube"]={name="Kunst Tube", tier=4, use="Use this consumable to improve the operator's combat performance.", desc="A booster packaged in a metal canister imbued with special Originium Arts. It contains sharp micro-clusters that can activate the user's vitals, excite the nervous system, and greatly accelerate adrenaline secretion.", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Jakub's Legacy"]={name="Jakub's Legacy", tier=4, use="Use this consumable to improve the operator's combat performance.", desc="Bread with a hardness akin to D64 Steel. The origins can be traced back to the time before the Landbreakers splintered into separate clans. According to the Landbreakers, the legendary warlord Jakub always had this on his dining table.", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Hub Emergency Ration"]={name="Hub Emergency Ration", tier=4, use="Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.", desc="An extremely hard and salty tack. After the decision to construct the Hub Base was made, the first Endfield operators arriving at Valley IV considered the possibility of supply shortage. Hence, they specifically added these emergency rations known for their extremely long shelf lives to the supply list.", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Superhot Fruit Preserves"]={name="Superhot Fruit Preserves", tier=4, use="Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.", desc="Fruit preserves with a sour and spicy flavor. Unripened citromes can be extremely sour, but cut them to pieces (along with the rind) and marinate them in a blend of tartpeppers and aggagrit condiments. The result is a refreshing riot of sour and spicy.", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Pulled Slug Meat"]={name="Pulled Slug Meat", tier=4, use="Use this consumable to restore the operator's HP.", desc="Slug meat that has been completely dehydrated. The pulled jerky is incredibly chewy. This is one of the best pet foods in Valley IV.", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Fortifying Infusion"]={name="Fortifying Infusion", tier=4, use="Use this consumable to improve the operator's combat performance.", desc="A herbal infusion prepared by decocting redjade ginseng and jincao herbs. Typically consumed to revitalize the body. Many grievously wounded warriors used this decoction to treat various chronic conditions.", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Chubby Lung Jellied Greens"]={name="Chubby Lung Jellied Greens", tier=4, use="Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.", desc="These jellied greens are bouncy and jiggly to the touch. Special molds were used by the manufacturers to create jellied greens shaped like Chubby Lung. It is the only option since everyone likes Chubby Lungs so much. Kyaaa! Chubby Lung! They're so cute!", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Pan-Fried Double Crisp"]={name="Pan-Fried Double Crisp", tier=4, use="Use this consumable to improve the operator's combat performance.", desc="A dish that poses a serious challenge to the chef. Quillbeast livers can quickly overcook and assume a texture similar to rubbery leather. A skilled cook must first come up with a way to give it the same tender crisp of young bamboo sprouts.", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Wuling Flame-Boyance"]={name="Wuling Flame-Boyance", tier=4, use="Use this consumable to improve the operator's combat performance.", desc="A generous and colorful dish. No one cares how the ingredient is cut or stir-fried, or how strong the fire is. Every Wuling household has their own Flame-Boyance approach.", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Simmered Xiranite Ball"]={name="Simmered Xiranite Ball", tier=4, use="Use this consumable to improve the operator's combat performance.", desc="Meatballs dyed in a way to make them resemble Xiranite. Although the resemblance is close enough to make diners hesitate, the tenderness, fragrance, and flavors are guaranteed to conquer every foodie.", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Garden Stir-Fry"]={name="Garden Stir-Fry", tier=4, use="Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.", desc="A dish prepared with a wok and intense fire. Stir-frying this only takes seconds. A blink or two longer and you'll get a disaster with abysmal texture.", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Ginseng Meat Stew"]={name="Ginseng Meat Stew", tier=5, use="Use this consumable to improve the operator's combat performance.", desc="A herbal meal prepared by stewing redjade ginseng roots, meat fillet, and other ingredients. A common winter dish of the Wuling region. When the snow starts falling, a bowl of this hearty stew would offer the warmth you need.", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Wuling Fried Rice"]={name="Wuling Fried Rice", tier=5, use="Use this consumable to improve the operator's combat performance.", desc="A mysterious Ursine chef came up with this recipe as he traveled across the lands. It became famous throughout the frontier for its delicious blend of sweetness and heat.", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Industrial Explosive"]={name="Industrial Explosive", tier=3, use="A packaged explosive. Can be used to directly attack targets. The resulting explosion deals damage to all nearby enemies.", desc="This is a dangerous explosive. Carry and use with care.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Echoing Remedy"]={name="Echoing Remedy", tier=3, use="Use this consumable to improve the operator's combat performance.", des="A mysterious remedy prepared using an improved formula based on ancient recipes. It can enhance the senses of its user.", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Braised Meat Noodles"]={name="Braised Meat Noodles", tier=4, use="Use this tactical to restore the HP of every operator in the team.", des="Braised meat noodles prepared with traditional methods, innovative elements, and fresh local produce of Wuling. A bowl of nostalgic flavors achieved via easy-to-learn steps. A brand new take on a well-loved dish from the past!", obtain="Mission Reward"},
	["Rhodes Island Special Ration"]={name="Rhodes Island Special Ration", tier=5, use="Use this tactical to restore the operator's Ultimate Energy.", desc="A mixed ration of Rhodes Island during the Age of Terra. The one who prepared it is absolutely certain of its authenticity. The production line was salvaged from the ruins of the Aggeloi War, and the replacement ingredients were foraged from various parts of Talos-II. Our memories have never been broken.", obtain="Mission Reward"},
	["Tian's Braised Meat Noodles"]={name="Tian's Braised Meat Noodles", tier=4, use="Use this tactical to restore the HP of every operator in the team.", desc="Braised meat noodles prepared with traditional methods, innovative elements, and fresh local produce of Wuling. A bowl of nostalgic flavors achieved via easy-to-learn steps. A brand new take on a well-loved dish from the past!", obtain="Mission rewards"},
	["Rind-Flavored Sprouts"]={name="Rind-Flavored Sprouts", tier=4, use="Use this consumable to improve the operator's combat performance.", desc="A delicious cold dish. Crunchy with a refreshing aroma. According to some veteran chef from Hongshan, the older the rind, the better the taste.", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Stonehold Remedy"]={name="Stonehold Remedy", tier=4, use="Use this consumable to improve the operator's combat performance.", desc="A mysterious remedy prepared using an improved formula based on ancient recipes. It can enhance energy conducting efficiency of the user's skeletal frame.", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Ruin-Purger Remedy"]={name="Ruin-Purger Remedy", tier=4, use="Use this consumable to improve the operator's combat performance.", desc="A mysterious remedy prepared using an improved formula based on ancient recipes. It is an effective dressing for wounds and for washing away pathogenic materials.", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Sear-Toasted Liver"]={name="Sear-Toasted Liver", tier=4, use="Use this tactical to restore the operator's HP.", desc="An easy-to-make dish that is popular amongst many frontiersmates. Simply sear liver with some salt, hang them over a wooden rack, and smoke them with tender sprigs. The result is most delicious and exquisite.", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Herbal Tisane"]={name="Herbal Tisane", tier=4, use="Use this tactical to restore the operator's Ultimate Energy.", desc="A refreshing drink with a flowery aroma that dispels the heat. Adding a quality glob of fine ink gives the drink fortifying properties that soothe the body and mind.", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	["Numbing Crispy Pupae"]={name="Numbing Crispy Pupae", tier=4, use="Use this consumable to improve the operator's combat performance.", desc="A serving of delicious deep-fried pupae. Do not consume too many of them at one go. \"Wait. I can't feel my tongue anymore... Did you season it with nine-tiered peppercorn...? What's this? A static build-up discharger? Why?\"", obtain="Unlock Crafting Manual formula to make this"},
	-----Inn Drinks-----
	["Bottled Duskberry Juice"]={name="Bottled Duskberry Juice", tier=5, use="A drink that can be served in Innkeeping. Grants certain effects when used.", desc="The highest quality berries are often known as \"Evening Dusk in Circulation\". Nevertheless, everyone who tasted this duskberry juice agrees on this fact: \"It's just liquid state sourberry.\"", obtain="Shop: Pantry Keep \"Job Rusher\", AIC Factory"},
	["Vintage Grapedew"]={name="Vintage Grapedew", tier=5, use="A drink that can be served in Innkeeping. Grants certain effects when used.", desc="Will this drop of aromatic grapedew remind you of the unforgiving weather, the carnage, and poetry of home?", obtain="Shop: Pantry Keep \"Job Rusher\""},
	["Pre-Tide Lungjing"]={name="Pre-Tide Lungjing", tier=5, use="A drink that can be served in Innkeeping. Grants certain effects when used.", desc="Brewed from leaves plucked from shrubs growing in the peripheral regions of Wuling before High Blight Tide. The tea is remarkably expensive due to its limited production.", obtain="Shop: Pantry Keep \"Job Rusher\""},
	["Bottled Milk (A)"]={name="Bottled Milk (A)", tier=4, use="A drink that can be served in Innkeeping. Grants certain effects when used.", desc="There is empirical evidence that children can still reach impressive heights without drinking this religiously. But this can be forgiven since this particular drink tastes great.", obtain="Shop: Pantry Keep \"Job Rusher\", AIC Factory"},
	["Seeker's Kohl"]={name="Seeker's Kohl", tier=4, use="A drink that can be served in Innkeeping. Grants certain effects when used.", desc="A famous distilled liquor falsely attributed to the Songseekers of the Hannabit Circuit. The kohl greets one's throat like oil poured over a red-hot pan, giving one a historical lesson on the brutality of the Aggeloi War.", obtain="Shop: Pantry Keep \"Job Rusher\""},
	["Pear Blossom Tea"]={name="Pear Blossom Tea", tier=4, use="A drink that can be served in Innkeeping. Grants certain effects when used.", desc="A pinch of pear blossom, a token of yearning and nostalgia.", obtain="Shop: Pantry Keep \"Job Rusher\""},
	["Bottled Canejuice"]={name="Bottled Canejuice", tier=3, use="A drink that can be served in Innkeeping. Grants certain effects when used.", desc="People might complain how sweet it is, or how it gives you ulcers if you drink too much. But in the end, this is still the most popular thing on the menu.", obtain="Shop: Pantry Keep \"Job Rusher\", AIC Factory"},
	["Corn Juice"]={name="Corn Juice", tier=3, use="A drink that can be served in Innkeeping. Grants certain effects when used.", desc="\"I'm not trying to be picky, but your corn juice is just like corn porridge. Can you explain what 'juice' means to you?\"", obtain="Shop: Pantry Keep \"Job Rusher\""},
	["Bottled Milk"]={name="Bottled Milk", tier=2, use="A drink that can be served in Innkeeping. Grants certain effects when used.", desc="There is empirical evidence that children who drink milk often tend to be taller.", obtain="Shop: Pantry Keep \"Job Rusher\", AIC Factory"},
	["Bowl of Tea"]={name="Bowl of Tea", tier=2, use="A drink that can be served in Innkeeping. Grants certain effects when used.", desc="A good kettle of quality crushed tea. Emerald crushing brewed in cascading water. The aroma can be picked up for miles.", obtain="Shop: Pantry Keep \"Job Rusher\""},
}
return data
